<thought>We need to find retrosynthetic templates that correspond to breaking a carboxylic acid (specifically an aliphatic carboxylic acid) to form an amide, i.e., the reverse of amide coupling. The valid functional group name is "aliphatic carboxylic acid". We'll search the template catalog with this corrected term and then apply each returned template to the target molecule to obtain the possible precursor sets.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-N"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
